description:
[0.98a] Alp Tweaks v1.5

Collection of quality of life tweaks.

Required mods: Patchlib and Lunalib

Safe to add mid-game

Not Safe to remove mid-game

No known mod conflicts

Configurable Tweaks
Market That Sells and Buys (mostly) Everything (M key): Press M in the campaign view to open a market that sells every weapon, wing, ship, commodity, blueprint and special item. you can close then reopen to refresh it.
Bigger Market Inventories: When a market restocks, its inventory is generated several times ( 2x-5x) and all batches are kept, so markets sells more stuff.
Better Patrol Transponder Interaction: With your transponder off and when you have a much stronger fleet, patrols avoid you instead of investigating you and damaging relations.
Clean Hyperspace: Removes hyperspace clouds and slipstreams. Applied on new game or when a save is loaded. Permenantly alters the save when enabled.
No False Detector Readings: Removes the fake signals the Neutrino Detector generates.
Linear Industry Improvement Cost: Improving an industry costs industryImproveBase * (1 + already improved) story points instead of the vanilla exponential doubling.
Contact Mission Quality Fix: Fixes the vanilla ContactIntel bug that overwrote the priority contact mission quality bonus with the mission count bonus.
No Colony Item Restrictions: Removes planet and condition requirements from colony items, so for example a Fullerene Spool can be installed on any world and a Biofactory Embryo does not require a habitable planet. Also stops nanoforges from causing pollution on habitable worlds. Applies to vanilla and modded items that use the standard item effects.
Fleet Speed Cap Increase: raises maximum campaign movement speed from 20 burn level to 30 burn level, you can go faster if you somehow get it above 20.

Disclaimer: Bigger market tweak can mess with commodity prices. Make sure to configure mod settings to your liking before loading a save.

Mod Menus

AI Use Disclaimer

Code: DeepSeek Flash 4.1

Other: You can copy, edit, share, fork this mod freely. I also know mod menu descriptions are ai slop, I might change it later.
